decision.comment:
Reporting stage is internally consistent and complete. No deterministic findings. Verification summary:

(1) Data integrity: All 11 audit checks passed; 28×28×3 RGB, 9-class multi-class, splits 89,996/10,004/7,180 consistent with standard MedMNIST PathMNIST. Train/val overlap = 0; test not inspected during training. No resolution substitution.

(2) Evaluation: Confusion matrix rows sum to per-class supports (verified all 9 rows); total = 7,180. Accuracy 0.919777 confirmed by diagonal sum. Per-class metrics internally consistent. Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) recall 0.439 (CI 0.393–0.487) is the weakest class; 87 misclassified as smooth muscle, 71 as debris. This is a model-quality observation, not a pipeline defect.

(3) OOD / Abstention: OOD aggregate AUROC for max_softmax = (0.755522 + 0.648461 + 0.607821)/3 = 0.670601, matching the reported value. Neither detector qualifies: max_softmax fails the FAR cap (0.287 > 0.20 at σ=0.4) and AUROC floor (0.608 < 0.65); predictive_entropy fails both (AUROC 0.428 < 0.65, FAR 0.472 > 0.20). detector_status = 'no_eligible_detector' is correct. The max_softmax threshold (0.9197) exceeds all observed confidence values on both validation and test, yielding 100% abstention, 0% coverage, and unit selective risk across all target coverage levels. This is a valid operational consequence of the calibration, not a computational error. All 7,180 test samples correctly routed to human review.

(4) Cross-stage consistency: Training (ok), Evaluation (warning), and Abstention (warning) anomaly reports are mutually consistent. The ~0.23 pp discrepancy between best_configuration.validation_accuracy and train_result.best_val_accuracy is within stochastic tolerance. LLM model digest is null for qwen3.8 (ollama) across all LLM-assisted stages — a traceability gap for full reproducibility of LLM-assisted decisions (warning, non-blocking).

(5) Cosmetic / record-hygiene items: 'E channel' typo in architecture research; compact_conv_token_transformer proposal description truncated; ingestion comment labels task 'multi-label' instead of 'multi-class'. None are functional defects.

No deterministic findings justify stop or revise. All warnings are valid, correctly identified, and non-blocking. The reporting dossier is complete through the abstention stage with 37 artefact versions and 84 decision events. Proceed.

No clinical claims. The supplied current UTC timestamp is authoritative. This pipeline uses the standard 28x28 RGB MedMNIST distribution; do not substitute the source-dataset or MedMNIST+ resolution. Only deterministic findings may justify action=stop; unsupported external-memory claims must be warnings requesting verification. ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
